idea-plugin.name: PostgreSQL 14 Upgrade Lint
idea-plugin.description:
PostgreSQL upgrade 14 → 17: finds the SQL and config lines that PostgreSQL 15, 16 and 17 removed, with the fix on each line

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → PostgreSQL 14 Upgrade Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 21 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/pg14-upgrade-blocker-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/pg14-upgrade-blocker-lint

action.text: PostgreSQL 14 Upgrade Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run PostgreSQL 14 Upgrade Lint on the file in the editor
